about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Vern Buchanan

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUNSHINE PROTECTION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SUNSHINE PROTECTION ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of my bill, the Sunshine Protection Act, which would make daylight saving time permanent and finally end the biannual clock switch.
My bill is simply a solution to make daylight saving time permanent.
Importantly, this bill allows States to opt out in favor of standard time if that is important to them.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HEALTH CARE EFFICIENCY THROUGH FLEXIBILITY ACT
statements.title: HEALTH CARE EFFICIENCY THROUGH FLEXIBILITY ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of my bill, the Health Care Efficiency Through Flexibility Act, which helps minimize burdens on value-based care organizations.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support the Health Care Efficiency Through Flexibility Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HOSPITAL INPATIENT SERVICES MODERNIZATION ACT
statements.title: HOSPITAL INPATIENT SERVICES MODERNIZATION ACT
sentences: I rise today in strong support of my bill, the Hospital Inpatient Services Modernization Act, which would allow hospitals to treat Medicare patients safely at home.
I urge my colleagues to support the hospital at home program extension for hospitals, providers, and patients.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PAYING TRIBUTE TO THE CONGRESSIONAL LAW ENFORCEMENT AWARDS RECIPIENTS OF FLORIDA'S 16TH CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT
statements.title: PAYING TRIBUTE TO THE CONGRESSIONAL LAW ENFORCEMENT AWARDS RECIPIENTS OF FLORIDA'S 16TH CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to pay tribute to law enforcement men and women who have provided distinguished service to the people of Florida's 16th Congressional District.
Law enforcement is a demanding profession that requires sacrifice, courage, and dedication to serve others.
Fifteen years ago, I established the 16th District Congressional Law Enforcement Awards to give special recognition to law enforcement officers, departments, or units for exceptional achievement.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CHRONIC DISEASE FLEXIBLE COVERAGE ACT
statements.title: CHRONIC DISEASE FLEXIBLE COVERAGE ACT
sentences: I rise today in strong support of my bill, the Chronic Disease Flexible Coverage Act.
I urge my colleagues to support this commonsense bill to help give Americans the tools they need for a longer, healthier, and happier life.
